(function(){function hx(c){c=(c||'').replace('#','').trim();if(c.length===3)c=c[0]+c[0]+c[1]+c[1]+c[2]+c[2];if(c.length<6)return null;return [parseInt(c.slice(0,2),16),parseInt(c.slice(2,4),16),parseInt(c.slice(4,6),16)];}function rgb(c){var m=(c||'').match(/[\d.]+/g);return m?m.map(Number):null;}function lin(x){x/=255;return x<=0.03928?x/12.92:Math.pow((x+0.055)/1.055,2.4);}function lum(a){return 0.2126*lin(a[0])+0.7152*lin(a[1])+0.0722*lin(a[2]);}function ratio(f,b){var x=lum(f),y=lum(b);var hi=Math.max(x,y),lo=Math.min(x,y);return (hi+0.05)/(lo+0.05);}function over(top,base){var a=top.length>3?top[3]:1;return [a*top[0]+(1-a)*base[0],a*top[1]+(1-a)*base[1],a*top[2]+(1-a)*base[2]];}function mk(cls){var d=document.createElement('div');d.className=cls;document.body.appendChild(d);return d;}var out=[];['brass','emerald','ivory'].forEach(function(t){document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t;var rs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);var bg1=hx(rs.getPropertyValue('--bg-1'));var p=mk('btn btn-primary');var pcs=getComputedStyle(p);var pfg=rgb(pcs.color),pbg=rgb(pcs.backgroundColor);p.remove();var e=mk('form-error');var ecs=getComputedStyle(e);var efg=rgb(ecs.color),ebg=rgb(ecs.backgroundColor);var ec=ecs.color;e.remove();var b=mk('banner error');var bcs=getComputedStyle(b);var bfg=rgb(bcs.color),bbg=rgb(bcs.backgroundColor);b.remove();out.push('['+t+'] btn-primary R='+ratio(pfg,pbg).toFixed(2)+' | form-error R='+ratio(efg,over(ebg,bg1)).toFixed(2)+' fg='+ec+' | banner.error R='+ratio(bfg,over(bbg,bg1)).toFixed(2)+' | ON_SIGNAL='+rs.getPropertyValue('--on-signal').trim()+' DANGER_FG='+rs.getPropertyValue('--danger-fg').trim());});document.documentElement.dataset.theme='brass';return out.join(' ### ');})()
